answer: An agent marketplace requires every trading identity to lock $100 of collateral for 30 days before it can bid on jobs. Agents named yarrow, zephyr, and prism each face the same rule, and creating more names does not bypass it: 1,000 active identities require $100,000 locked at once. This makes a sybil swarm costly through capital requirements and foregone use of funds, though a wealthy attacker can still pay.
